title: 菊花賞の後に・青空は遠くとも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky loses the Kikuka Sho, the final race of the Classic Triple Crown. Still, the audience cheers her incredible performance during the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky praises Special Week for her hard work in the Classics. At the same time, the third member of the big three, King Halo, watches in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Seiun Sky is unsure of which race to do next, on the way home she hears from a fan that Grass Wonder will run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Encouraged by her fans, Seiun Sky sets her sights on the Arima Kinen so she can defeat Grass Wonder and become the best in her generation.
